name: Novelcrafter
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Novelcrafter, organize a novel bible, scenes, characters, and optional bring-your-own-model drafting. The hard boundary is its mature manuscript workflow, codex structure, and community templates, plus polish, integrations, and proprietary language models.
